text: The horizon temperature $T_Q$ does not depend on the state.

CLPW's entropy is the renormalized entropy of a Type II$_1$ algebra, defined up to an additive constant that does not depend on the state; it is not the ordinary von Neumann entropy of a finite-dimensional density matrix used in the framework.
Under H-balance, $T_Q$ does not depend on the state within the probed window.
L4 (the graph of an additive update does not depend on the state) is proved in §4.2.
